item: Wikimedia names survive a resolver blip, behind the SSRF guard
summary: Every Wikipedia call failed during a resolver blip (a Qubes net VM). The patched getaddrinfo now keeps the last good all-public answer for wikipedia.org, wikimedia.org and wikidata.org names and hands it back only for EAI_AGAIN, within 10 minutes, on the same network (own interface addresses from the kernel tables), after asking the resolver first. The airplane refusal runs before it, engaging airplane mode empties it, and the remembered answer meets check_resolution and the connect-time check like a fresh one. Stated limit: EAI_AGAIN also covers SERVFAIL and REFUSED, so a DNS block starting on the same network is ridden over for at most 10 minutes. Memory only, 64 entries, OO_DNS_STALE=0 off. Two security reads, no must-fix.
